note: Norfolk Island is an external Territory of Australia; the Australian Citizenship Act 2007 (Compilation No. 37, 4 June 2026, read 2026-10-30) counts the external Territories as Australia in a geographical sense and extends to them, so its people are Australia's citizens. The game reads that they hold Australia's number, the Tax File Number, which the Australian Taxation Office issues on application to anyone who deals with it (Australia's file). Not read: an ATO page on the Territory's own tax (ato.gov.au answered 403 on 2026-10-30), so the reading rests on citizenship, not on the tax law's own extension.
